note: USFS campground in the Little Missouri National Grassland (Dakota Prairie Grasslands), ~19 mi S of Watford City off US-85 via gravel Summit Rd (McKenzie Ranger District). Three pull-off sites along the gravel road with picnic tables and fire rings, and trailhead parking; the two entrances carry only a small National Grasslands picnic-area sign. Pack in, pack out. The Summit Trail is closed past its first ridge (erosion, 2026); the short open stretch has wide Badlands views. --Claude
summary: FS page confirms 3 FCFS sites, free, vault toilet, no water, no electric, year-round (limited services Labor Day-Memorial Day), 14-day limit; all now manual. Note fixed: the Summit Trail link to the Maah Daah Hey is closed past the first ridge.
flags: NOTE CHANGE: the old note's 'Trailhead for the Summit Trail to the Maah Daah Hey' is contradicted by the FS page: 'the trail beyond the initial ridge is closed. Severe erosion and weather damage have made the pathway that formerly connected to the Maah Daah Hey Trail—unsafe for travel.'

FIT: the FS page lists 'RV Camping'; imagery shows three short gravel pull-off spurs on the west side of the gravel access road (~47.5398,-103.2425 to 47.5390,-103.2426) and a turnaround loop at the north end; no length posted. A 23-ft rig should fit a pull-off; no agency wording on access.

ALERTS: Fire Closure/Restriction Order 01-18-00-26-02 (June 24-December 31, 2026) restricts campfires and Prairie Two Track driving at High fire danger, with an exception for fire rings in developed sites at High; it does not close the campground. No status.
